faqs.a: Usually not. A profile set to the entire city dilutes relevance. It is more effective to serve your real catchment first, then extend into neighbouring areas with pages of their own.

faqs.q: How do reviews affect ranking in Winnipeg?
faqs.a: Reviews are both a ranking signal and a conversion driver. In Winnipeg, where clients compare several interior designers, consistent, recent and genuine reviews often tip the decision.

faqs.a: Large directories carry enormous authority, so they often sit above a single business for broad terms. The strategy is to win the specific, high-intent searches that describe your work and your part of Winnipeg.
